<div class="ref-table">

| Property | What it is |
|---|---|
| `plugins` | Plugins for this form alone, beside those the page registered with plugins.register: FormPlugin objects whose components join the catalogue, whose validators run after the field constraints, and whose hooks, submission handlers, PDF renditions, sandbox modules and data sources the form takes up. A property only. Assigning rebuilds the form and keeps the answers typed so far. |
| `componentDefinitions` | Component types beyond the standard catalogue, each drawn by its definition's adapter; a type with a standard one's name replaces it. Assigning rebuilds the form and keeps the answers typed so far. |
| `themes`<br>`pluginRegistry` | The registries the element resolves through: themes for the pdf-theme id, pluginRegistry for the page's plugins. Each is the page's shared one (the themes and plugins exports) unless a host hands the element its own. A plugin registered after the element connected is taken up: the form is rebuilt, and the answers typed so far stay. |
| `binding`<br>`assets`<br>`colorScheme` | The design-system binding the form is drawn by (a LiveBinding, or the id of one registered with bindings.register; Datum's when left out), the files that binding needs (stylesheets, fonts, scripts), and light or dark. |
| `dataSources`<br>`messages`<br>`texts`<br>`values` | Object forms of the attributes of the same name; the property takes functions where the attribute cannot. |
| `signingProviders`<br>`pdfSigner`<br>`pdfSignature`<br>`signing` | Functions: a passkey provider, a hardware-token signer. |
| `serverValidator`<br>`draftStore`<br>`wasmValidationHost`<br>`wasmPlugins`<br>`wasmExternalData` | Custom objects behind validate-url, draft and wasm. |
| `pdfSupport`<br>`pdfTemplates` | A loaded PDF module and a template resolver behind pdf. |
| `ready` | Read-only promise: resolves after datum-ready for the current definition (at once when the form is ready already), rejects with the build error (the journeys runtime that did not arrive, a definition the runtime refused), is not rejected by a build a newer request replaced, and is a fresh promise after the next build or Retry. With no definition it settles once one is set and built. |

</div>
